messages.content: Booking request created: 88233658/1.
The jobsheet associated with this VOR incident has been completed. Please review the incident to ensure it is current and up to date.
Vehicle off road. To book a taxi over the phone, call CMAC and quote reference 48102825.
Authority deferred update recorded.
A MMR case has been raised. Vehicle will be repaired by IAA.
Hi, when are you looking to collect this vehicle?
We are awaiting decision from the case manager as this is an MMR case.
Has a decision been made by the case manager?
No, it does not look as if we have been instructed yet.
Booking request created: 88269240/1.
Vehicle had a fault with EC. Customer was advised to take vehicle back to branch. A new booking was created without hire.
Do you have an update on this one?
We have had no instruction to collect this vehicle.
Work is now authorised. When will you be collecting this vehicle, or is the vehicle on site?
We are attempting to contact the dealer to arrange collection. We are hoping for Tuesday or Wednesday as long as the vehicle is not stripped.
Can you please provide an update?
The vehicle is on site and waiting for a ramp.
Do you have an update on repairs, please?
Vehicle is on site awaiting ramp to start; repair start expected in 15-20 working days from collection.
Please confirm the earliest workshop date available, expected repair duration, and estimated completion date.
Quoted timeline is 15-20 days from arrival on site to start; this takes us to the first week in June.
Any update on this please?
Vehicle is on site awaiting ramp to start.
Can you please provide a repair update?
Vehicle remains on site awaiting a ramp to start.
Do you have an ETA for when the ramp will start?
Vehicle arrived on site on 06/05 and was due to start in 20-25 working days from that date.
